# hush_github_app_access_credential (Resource)

Manage GitHub App access credentials in the Hush Security platform. The access manager mints short-lived installation tokens from the App's private key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a GitHub App access credential. The access manager mints short-lived
# installation tokens from the App's private key.
resource "hush_github_app_access_credential" "example" {
  name            = "prod-github-app"
  description     = "Production GitHub App credential"
  deployment_ids  = [hush_deployment.example.id]
  client_id       = "Iv23liExampleClient1"
  installation_id = "12345678"

  private_key_wo         = var.github_app_private_key
  private_key_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) The GitHub App's client ID, shown on its settings page: 1-64 letters, digits and dots. Older `Iv1.<hex>` client IDs are accepted, as is the numeric App ID
- `deployment_ids` (List of String) List of deployment IDs that can access this credential. Currently limited to a single deployment. Changing this after creation is not supported; the credential must be deleted and recreated.
- `installation_id` (String) The ID of the App's installation on the account whose repositories the tokens reach: a positive integer of at most 19 digits, without leading zeros
- `name` (String) The name of the GitHub App access credential

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `description` (String) The description of the GitHub App access credential
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) The GitHub App's private key: the unencrypted RSA key in PEM format, as downloaded from the App's settings page
- `private_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The GitHub App's private key (write-only): the unencrypted RSA key in PEM format. More secure than `private_key` because Terraform will not store this value in the state file.
- `private_key_wo_version` (String) Used to trigger updates for `private_key_wo`. Change when the private key changes.
- `secret_store_id` (String) The ID of the secret store where this credential is saved (optional)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the GitHub App access credential
- `kind` (String) The kind of access credential
- `type` (String) The type of access credential
